cohort: The study included 100 patients who had undergone cesarean section, divided into two groups of fifty.
finding: Prophylactic single dose of ceftriaxone was effective in reducing infective morbidity, offered cost benefits, and potentially reduces chances of drug resistance compared to multiple dose regimens.
mod_finding: The study focused on women undergoing cesarean section, finding that a single dose of ceftriaxone prophylaxis was effective in reducing infective morbidity in this mode of birth.
